text:
## Ask you first

1. **Token on this Mac.** Setup with `--repo` makes this Mac a broker that holds a Codeberg token in the macOS secret store. Is that OK? Everything below depends on it.
2. **Is `me/notes` public or private?** If it's public, I need your explicit yes to `--allow-public`. Fork PRs never run, but code you merge from outsiders would run on this Mac. I'd assume private unless you say otherwise.
3. **Memory budget (optional).** The default is a quarter of RAM every day and half while plugged in. Tell me if you want different numbers, e.g. `--memory 4GiB --boost-memory 12GiB`.

## The token (you make it, I never see it)

On Codeberg, go to **Settings > Applications** and create a token with scopes `write:repository` and `read:user`. Don't paste it into this chat.

## What I'd run now (no sudo needed)

```sh
tentmaker version --json; tentmaker status --json
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/baney75/tentmaker/main/scripts/install.sh | sh -s -- --no-setup
tentmaker version --json
```

The first line should show it's not installed. The installer will put the binary in `~/.local/bin`, since I have no root. I'll use whatever full path it prints for the later commands.

## What you run (sudo needs a password I can't type)

Run this in your own terminal, with the full path to `tentmaker` if it isn't on root's PATH. Paste the token, press Enter, then Ctrl-D:

```sh
sudo tentmaker setup --yes --json --forge forgejo --forge-url https://codeberg.org --repo me/notes --token-stdin
```

Codeberg runs Forgejo, hence `--forge forgejo`. It runs in checks mode, so jobs post `tentmaker/<job name>` commit statuses. If you picked memory numbers, add `--memory` and `--boost-memory`.

## After you tell me it's done

```sh
tentmaker doctor --json
tentmaker repo list --json
tentmaker status --json
```

I'll fix anything `doctor` flags and rerun it. If the same problem survives two fixes, I'll stop and report it. I won't call setup done until `doctor` exits 0.

No workflow migration is needed in checks mode. If you want Tentmaker's results to gate merges, make the `tentmaker/...` statuses required in Codeberg branch protection.
